svg.title: Omitting obsolete terminal painting
svg.desc: A reverse visibility proof marks obsolete text as ghost runs. In a 32-column terminal grid, the cursor visibly advances past 19 ghost characters without writing cells. After a clear, the terminal paints READY in red, then disables autowrap while preserving terminal state.

g.text: Six runs are ready. All input stays in order.
Scan backward to find the later full-screen clear.
Earlier text will update state, but not write cells.
loading... advances the cursor; the grid stays blank.
CSI 31 m changes the foreground to red.
old frame advances the cursor; still no cell writes.
CSI 2 J erases cells without moving the cursor.
READY paints five red cells at the current position.
CSI ? 7 l disables automatic line wrapping.
Same terminal state, without obsolete cell writes.
